title: Compose an experimental mixed-source Big Beat sketch
description: Create and audition a fresh Big Beat score that deliberately departs from both Fence Signal and Circuit Breaker through a new source world, drum identity, and 16-bar sectional logic. Render and measure for listener review before cloud publication.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Recast the experimental score around two actual St. Patrick’s parade recordings: the long E-minor scene from 001 supplies the main hook and the E-minor loop from 002 supplies the tighter counter-groove. The rolling-break drum identity was auditioned first. Full render is 103.49 objective_v2 with no v2 guard violations; steering offered only a narrow F2 notch on the raw parade texture, intentionally not applied before listener review.
